profile.name: Enzo Dinglasan
profile.summary: I build web products and browser games, from the first prototype through production. Over 10 years, my work has covered SaaS, e-commerce, fintech, logistics, and interactive 3D experiences, with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, and Three.js at the core.

projects.title: Arckyv
projects.description: A chronological way to explore pop culture across movies, music, television, books, and video games.
bullets: Explore a shared cultural timeline with filters and flexible views.
Built with Google AI Studio / Gemini as part of my independent product work.

experience.summary: Built browser-based Plinko and slot games, owning development from the initial technical setup to production delivery.
bullets: Built a 3D Plinko game from scratch with Three.js and TypeScript, including gameplay and physics integration.
Evaluated Rapier and Cannon.js to refine physics behavior and performance.
Created 2D Plinko and casino slot games with PixiJS, and extended existing game-engine components for new 3-by-8 slot layouts.
Optimized Three.js for mobile devices and shipped games to AWS S3 through GitHub Actions.

experience.summary: Created an MVP logistics platform for tracking daily deliveries and transaction records.
bullets: Built the application from the ground up using Next.js, Python, and PostgreSQL.
Designed backend APIs and relational data models for delivery locations, status updates, comments, and timestamps.
Containerized the application and deployed it with Docker, Nginx, and AWS EC2.

experience.summary: Delivered features across planning, fintech, and equipment-rental products while taking over existing applications and supporting production releases.
bullets: Worked across frontend applications, backend APIs, database structures, security fixes, and cloud deployments.
Adapted to existing Angular and Django applications and guided a junior developer on implementation work.

projects.title: TRAQPLAN — Project planning & portfolio visualization
projects.description: Took over an existing Angular 13 and Express.js SaaS application after the lead developer's departure.
bullets: Continued feature delivery across Angular, RxJS, PrimeNG, Express.js, PostgreSQL, and Power BI.
Supported the core application, Power BI solution, and Next.js marketing-site deployments using Docker, Rancher, and Microsoft Azure.
Fixed high-risk application vulnerabilities identified through penetration testing.

projects.title: TERASEKONE — Fintech web platform
projects.description: Joined an existing fintech application to help deliver the project, adapting to Python and Django while working across the frontend and backend.
bullets: Built React / Vite components and Django API endpoints in an existing PostgreSQL application.
Worked with AWS S3 and RDS alongside the lead developer.

projects.title: SMARTRENTAL — Equipment rental & subscriptions
projects.description: Developed features for an office-equipment rental e-commerce platform.
bullets: Implemented Next.js frontend features and GraphQL integrations, contributing to data-structure decisions.
Guided a junior developer through assigned components and provided technical support.

experience.summary: Built a restaurant e-commerce platform for online ordering and customer transactions.
bullets: Developed the application with React and TypeScript.
Implemented cloud functionality using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SNS, S3, IAM, Route 53, and EC2.

experience.summary: Delivered dashboard pages and features for the ToothAndCoin app.
bullets: Built application interfaces using Next.js, TypeScript, Material UI, and Tailwind CSS.
Integrated data with Sequelize and PostgreSQL in a Docker-based environment.

experience.summary: Developed a serverless directory web application.
bullets: Built the frontend with Next.js, TypeScript, Material UI, and GraphQL.
Worked with AWS S3, Lambda@Edge, DynamoDB, CloudFront, CloudFormation, Route 53, and CloudWatch.

experience.summary: Developed features for Upflowy, a SaaS platform for building customer flows and improving conversion.
bullets: Built reusable components with React, TypeScript, Node.js, GrapesJS, and Tailwind CSS.
Integrated and maintained Firebase / Firestore and HubSpot services for application data and customer workflows.

experience.summary: Designed and built an e-commerce platform for a digital printing company, while managing a small Agile development team.
bullets: Designed the application structure and implemented it with MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js, and TypeScript.
Delivered state management, authentication, payments, and email functionality with Redux, JWT, Passport.js, Stripe, and Nodemailer.
Coordinated the team's development work through delivery, with Docker and Heroku supporting development and deployment.

experience.summary: Built and maintained HTML5 casino games and white-label gaming websites.
bullets: Developed browser games with Phaser.js, WebSockets, Node.js, and JavaScript.
Temporarily managed the development department, coordinated project status with the CEO and other managers, and participated in developer interviews.

experience.summary: Customized Shopify themes and supported the day-to-day needs of an online store.
bullets: Modified storefront themes using Shopify and Liquid.
Supported product and inventory management.

experience.summary: Built browser games, websites, and mobile applications while supporting the company's technical environment.
bullets: Created a side-scrolling browser game with ImpactJS and the Bayang Matuwid website with WordPress.
Converted the browser game and a volunteer web application into mobile apps using AngularJS, Ionic, and Cordova.
Maintained computer networks, hardware, software, and related configurations.

experience.summary: Early work across software development, inventory systems, networks, IT infrastructure, and technical support.
bullets: EES Enterprise: 2009 - 2011.
Tres Hermanas Inc: 2010 - 2013.
